name: mixed
about: Three vendors, each in a role it measured well: Gemini researches, Codex plans, Claude codes and verifies. A second vendor's view of the design catches what one model's blind spots miss.

why.research: Gemini 4 Carbon: 63.7 on SWE-Atlas-QnA, within a few points of the leaders, at a fraction of their cost.
why.plan: GPT-6 Astra at xhigh: least verbose code and best strict solve on SlopCodeBench, third on LibraryDesignBench; an independent design view from the model that will not write the code.
why.code: Opus 5.5: joint first on Terminal-Bench 4.1; best value in SlopCodeBench's top ten.
why.verify: Opus 5.5 at xhigh, as LaneLoop has always verified.
